create_synthetic_reward_training_data: create synthetic training data with random states, actions, and linear reward for reward network testing
create_sequence_reward_training_data: create sequence-based training data with left and right shifted features for ngram reward model testing
train_and_evaluate_reward_net: train a reward network trainer on batches of data and return average evaluation loss
test_single_step_reward_net: test that a single step synthetic reward network fails to learn multi-step parametric rewards
test_ngram_fc_reward_net: test that an ngram fully connected reward network learns sequence-based parametric rewards below a loss threshold
